samples.xml_description:
<module id="radix2_div">
    <description>A simplified radix-2 divider for 8-bit signed or unsigned integers.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">The clock signal for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst">The reset signal to initialize or reset the module.</input>
        <input id="sign">Indicates if the operation is signed (1) or unsigned (0).</input>
        <input id="dividend" width_description="[7:0]">The input dividend for division.</input>
        <input id="divisor" width_description="[7:0]">The input divisor for division.</input>
        <input id="opn_valid">Indicates that a valid operation request is present.</input>
        <output id="res_valid">Indicates the result is valid and ready.</output>
        <output id="result" width_description="[15:0]">The output containing the remainder in the upper 8 bits and the quotient in the lower 8 bits.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="IDLE">State IDLE = 0;</parameter>
        <parameter id="START">State START = 1;</parameter>
        <parameter id="DIVIDE">State DIVIDE = 2;</parameter>
        <parameter id="DONE">State DONE = 3;</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <signal id="neg_divisor" width_description="[9:0]">The negative value of the divisor.</signal>
        <signal id="sr" width_description="[17:0]">Shift register for storing the dividend during division.</signal>
        <signal id="sub_result" width_description="[9:0]">The result of subtracting the divisor from the current shift register.</signal>
        <signal id="carry_out">The carry-out bit from the subtraction.</signal>
        <signal id="mux_out" width_description="[9:0]">The selected output from the mux.</signal>
        <signal id="cnt">The counter for keeping track of the number of iterations.</signal>
        <signal id="start_cnt">A flag to indicate the start of the division process.</signal>
        <signal id="done">A flag to indicate the completion of the division process.</signal>
        
        // Combinational logic for calculating the negative divisor
        assign neg_divisor[9:0] = {~(|divisor[7:0]), ~divisor[7:0]} + 1;
        // Combinational logic for performing subtraction
        assign sub_result[9:0] = sr[17:8] + neg_divisor[9:0];
        // Combinational logic for determining the carry-out bit
        assign carry_out = sub_result[9];
        // Combinational logic for selecting the output from the mux
        assign mux_out[9:0] = (carry_out == 1'b1) ? sub_result[9:0] : {1'b0, sr[17:9]};
        // Combinational logic for updating the shift register
        assign sr[17:0] = {mux_out[8:0], sr[8]};
        // Combinational logic for incrementing the counter
        assign cnt = (start_cnt == 1'b1 && done == 1'b0) ? cnt + 1 : 0;
        // Combinational logic for setting the start_cnt flag
        assign start_cnt = (opn_valid == 1'b1 && res_valid == 1'b0) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0;
        // Combinational logic for setting the done flag
        assign done = (cnt[3] == 1'b1) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0;
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        Always block triggered on the positive edge of the clock or the active low reset signal
        if(rst == 1'b0) begin
            // Reset all registers and flags to their initial values
            cnt <= 0;
            start_cnt <= 0;
            res_valid <= 0;
            sr <= 0;
        end else begin
            // Check if the operation is valid and the result is not yet valid
            if(opn_valid == 1'b1 && res_valid == 1'b0) begin
                // Save the dividend and divisor inputs to the corresponding registers
                dividend_reg <= dividend;
                divisor_reg <= divisor;
                
                // Initialize the shift register with the dividend shifted left by one bit
                sr <= {{8{1'b0}}, dividend_reg};
                
                // Set the negative divisor to its negated value
                neg_divisor_reg <= neg_divisor;
                
                // Set the counter to 1 and the start_cnt flag to 1 to start the division process
                cnt <= 1;
                start_cnt <= 1;
            end
            
            // Check if the counter is greater than 0 and less than 8
            if(cnt > 0 && cnt < 8) begin
                // Update the shift register with the result of the subtraction
                sr <= mux_out;
                
                // Increment the counter
                cnt <= cnt + 1;
            end
            
            // Check if the counter is equal to 8
            if(cnt == 8) begin
                // Clear the counter and the start_cnt flag
                cnt <= 0;
                start_cnt <= 0;
                
                // Update the shift register with the final remainder and quotient
                sr <= {mux_out[8:0], sr[8]};
            end
            
            // Check if the counter is greater than 0
            if(cnt > 0) begin
                // Set the result_valid flag to 1 to indicate that the result is valid
                res_valid <= 1;
            end else begin
                // Set the result_valid flag to 0 to indicate that the result is not valid
                res_valid <= 0;
            end
        end
    </implementation>
    
    <task id="reset">
        <description>Resets the module's internal states and registers.</description>
        <step>Set the counter 'cnt' to 0.</step>
        <step>Set the start counter 'start_cnt' to 0.</step>
        <step>Set the result valid 'res_valid' to 0.</step>
        <step>Clear the shift register 'sr' to 0.</step>
    </task>
    
    <task id="load_inputs">
        <description>Loads the inputs into the module's internal registers.</description>
        <step>Save the dividend input to the 'dividend_reg' register.</step>
        <step>Save the divisor input to the 'divisor_reg' register.</step>
        <step>Initialize the shift register 'sr' with the dividend shifted left by one bit.</step>
        <step>Calculate the negative divisor and save it to the 'neg_divisor_reg' register.</step>
        <step>Set the counter 'cnt' to 1.</step>
        <step>Set the start counter 'start_cnt' to 1.</step>
    </task>
    
    <task id="divide_operation">
        <description>Performs the division operation.</description>
        <step>Update the shift register 'sr' with the result of the subtraction.</step>
        <step>Increment the counter 'cnt' by 1.</step>
        <step>Check if the counter 'cnt' is equal to 8:</step>
        <sub_step>Clear the counter 'cnt' and the start counter 'start_cnt' to 0.</sub_step>
        <sub_step>Update the shift register 'sr' with the final remainder and quotient.</sub_step>
    </task>
    
    <task id="set_result_valid">
        <description>Sets the result valid flag.</description>
        <step>Check if the counter 'cnt' is greater than 0:</step>
        <sub_step>Set the result valid 'res_valid' to 1 to indicate that the result is valid.</sub_step>
        <sub_step>Set the result valid 'res_valid' to 0 to indicate that the result is not valid.</sub_step>
    </task>
</module>
